OpenX ad server downloads compromised serving malware

Target: openx
Repository: N/A
Date: 2013-08-01 to 2013-12-06 (127 days)
Attribution: Cybercriminal Gang
Component: Application
Language: PHP
Cause: Compromised Infrastructure
Motive: Financial Gain
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Unauthorized System Modification, Malware Propagation
User Impact:
Domain: openx.com (project download host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The infrastructure serving downloads and updates for the OpenX Source ad server software was compromised. Attackers modified official software packages to include malicious code. This code redirected website visitors viewing ads served by compromised OpenX servers to the Styx exploit kit, infecting end-users.

Compromised Versions

  • OpenX Source 2.8.10
